rules.name: Credentials Transmitted Over Unencrypted Channel
rules.description: Detects login or credential submission over HTTP instead of HTTPS exposing credentials to interception
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
authentication_events
| where authentication has_any("wstg", "authentication", "cleartext-credentials", "encryption")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold

| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
